d:
Thick, wavy deep-crimson hair that falls to the shoulders. Determined, focused sapphire-blue eyes. Appears to be in the early twenties with a mature, noble expression. A sturdy, athletic build. Wears a high-collared white tunic under polished silver plate armor with gold trim and a flowing red cape. A gold circlet rests upon the brow.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
